meta.name: deployment-pipeline-design
meta.description: Design multi-stage CI/CD pipelines with approval gates, security checks, and deployment orchestration. Use this skill when designing zero-downtime deployment pipelines, implementing canary rollout strategies, setting up multi-environment promotion workflows, or debugging failed deployment gates in CI/CD.

copy.tagline: 设计可回滚、带安全审批的发布流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的团队需要规划安全、零停机的软件发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Design gated, rollback-ready release pipelines for zero-downtime deployment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to design secure, zero-downtime multi-environment release workflows

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你设计多阶段 CI/CD 流水线时,给出阶段定义、部署策略(如金丝雀/蓝绿)、健康检查、审批门禁和回滚计划等设计方案,并能针对常见部署问题给出排查建议。
howto.when: 当你说要设计零停机部署流水线、实施金丝雀/蓝绿发布,或调试 CI/CD 中失败的审批门禁时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一条多环境 CI/CD 流水线,带审批门禁和自动回滚。
say.note: Claude 会给出阶段与门禁配置。

say.text: 配置金丝雀发布,用 Prometheus 指标做自动晋升判断。
say.note: 会生成含 AnalysisTemplate 的配置。

say.text: 生产环境部署卡在审批门禁,帮我排查原因。
say.note: 按排障章节定位保护规则等问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps design multi-stage CI/CD pipelines, producing stage definitions, deployment strategy (canary/blue-green), health checks, approval gates, and rollback plans, plus troubleshooting advice for common deployment failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design zero-downtime deployment pipelines, implement canary or blue-green rollouts, set up multi-environment promotion workflows, or debug failed approval gates in CI/CD.

say_en.text: Design a multi-environment CI/CD pipeline with approval gates and automatic rollback.
say_en.note: Claude outputs stage and gate configuration.

say_en.text: Configure a canary rollout using Prometheus metrics for auto-promotion.
My production deploy is stuck at the approval gate; help me debug.
say_en.note: It checks environment protection rules and related issues.
